text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Charities hope that political fund-raising will not hurt their own efforts. Charities normally use Christmas for their main fund raising activites. This year both Malta's political parties have launched Christmas appeals to fund their television stations.
- Opposition leader Edward Fenech Adami accuses Prime Minister Alfred Sant of acting illegally, saying Sant should by law have invited him to nominate directors for state-owned companies.
- Prime Minister Sant appears at fund-raising function for Labour Party television station.
- Police drugs squad opposes holding of New Year's rave parties, fearing drug trafficking.
